page.title: Delivery
page.purpose: Show which notifications reached a channel and what still needs attention.

states.description: The first read is in flight; placeholder rows hold the place and are announced as loading.
Records are shown while channel reliability could not be read; that panel offers its own retry.
The read failed: the cause is named with a retry, or the sign-in card when the owner session is missing.
Rows from an earlier read stay on screen while a refresh runs, and the footer says how long ago they were updated.
